description.content: This document provides an electronic Bill of Lading (eBOL). The eBOL is a legal document that provides a contract between the shipper, carrier and consignee stating what goods are being shipped, where the shipment is coming from and where it’s headed to. “Pro” number is the unique identifier for the document for update and delete functions.
